## Further reading {#sec-permutation-reading}

- @good2005permutation is a book-length treatment of permutation tests.
- @phipson2010permutation explains why Monte Carlo permutation p-values need the added 1.
- Chapter 13 of @james2021islr2e applies permutation and other resampling methods to multiple testing.
